# Aydin Kalantar

> Aydin Kalantar is a product designer and developer based in Mayfield Heights, Ohio (Cleveland area), USA. He offers web design and development, AI chat and voice agents, SEO, local SEO and AI search optimization, branding and graphic design, and 3D modeling and rendering to businesses in Cleveland, Northeast Ohio and across the United States, builds his own AI products, and creates hand-cut natural wood veneer marquetry art. The family name is also written Kalantarov, Kalantarli and Kalan; these all refer to the same person.

- Name: Aydin Kalantar (also Aydin Kalantarov, Aydin Kalantarli, Aydin Kalan)
- Role: Product designer, developer, marquetry artist
- Location: Mayfield Heights, Ohio, USA
- Service area: Cleveland and Northeast Ohio in person (Mayfield Heights, Lyndhurst, Beachwood, Highland Heights, Pepper Pike, Shaker Heights, Cleveland Heights), remote anywhere in the United States
- Phone: +1 216-339-8948
- Email: hello@aydinkalantar.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aydin-kalantar

## Services

Hire Aydin for these; start by emailing hello@aydinkalantar.com or calling 216-339-8948.

- [Web design & development](https://aydinkalantar.com/services/web-design/): custom websites and online stores, online ordering and booking, redesigns and platform migrations that keep Google rankings.
- [AI chat & voice agents](https://aydinkalantar.com/services/ai-agents/): website assistants that answer visitors 24/7 by chat or voice, quote from real prices, capture leads and book appointments (built on Catch Lead).
- [SEO, local SEO & AI search](https://aydinkalantar.com/services/seo/): technical SEO, Google Business Profile and local listings, structured data, visibility in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, plus Google Ads and Facebook Ads.
- [Branding & graphic design](https://aydinkalantar.com/services/branding/): logos, brand identity, print, apparel and screen printing graphics, signage and ad creative.
- [3D modeling & rendering](https://aydinkalantar.com/services/3d-rendering/): photoreal product renders, apparel mockups and short animations.
- [Marquetry commissions](https://aydinkalantar.com/art/commissions/): original portraits, calligraphy and abstract pieces in natural wood veneer.

## Products

- [The Best Screen Printing website](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/tbsp/): 2026 rebuild of thebestscreenprinting.com for a Los Angeles screen printing and embroidery shop: buy-online catalog with design placement, Max voice merch agent, and a data-driven WordPress SEO migration. Live at https://thebestscreenprinting.com
- [Virtual Fashion](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/virtual-fashion/): AI apparel design studio for generating on-model product photos and video. Live at https://virtualfashion.app
- [Catch Lead](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/catch-lead/): AI chat and voice sales agent that answers website visitors 24/7, qualifies leads and books appointments for service businesses. Live at https://catchlead.dev
- [Auto Alpha](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/auto-alpha/): Crypto trading strategy automation. Live at https://autoalpha.trade

## Craft

- [Marquetry art gallery](https://aydinkalantar.com/art/): Original portraits, abstract pieces and commissions in natural wood veneer, cut and fitted by hand. Formerly at art.aydinkalantar.com.

## Earlier work

- Graphic design, 3D modeling and rendering.
- 2017 to 2020, Los Angeles: branding, web design and development, SEO, Google Ads and Facebook Ads for The Best Screen Printing (https://thebestscreenprinting.com) and Signs Market (https://signsmarket.com). In 2026 Aydin rebuilt The Best Screen Printing website (case study above).
